entities.summary: Roberto de Assis Moreira, commonly known as Assis, is a Brazilian former footballer who played as a midfielder, and who is also the brother, manager, agent and adviser of footballer Ronaldinho. He is also the owner of Porto Alegre Futebol Clube.
